svg.title: Serving many freelancers: a design, not built
svg.desc: A design, not built. Many freelancers connect their own PayPal business account once through Log in with PayPal and an invoicing permission. Their tokens are kept encrypted in a token vault. A signed session cookie carries the tenant ID, so every route runs for one tenant and reaches Postgres through storeFor(tenant), with a tenant ID on every row and row-level security as a second defence. One app-level webhook endpoint finds the tenant from an invoice index. A frequent cron claims each tenant's morning run. Each tenant has a model budget under one shared ceiling, and exchange rates stay shared.
svg.text: Decision 0019. Nothing on this page exists in the code yet.
Log in with PayPal and an invoicing permission.
Proxy: the session gives the tenant
Never from the body or the URL
Every request runs for one tenant
Every query already carries the tenant
invoice_index finds the tenant, then a fresh read

g.text: Each freelancer connects their own PayPal account once
Their tokens are kept encrypted in a vault
A signed session gives every request its tenant
Routes call PayPal with that tenant's own token
storeFor(tenant) reaches Postgres, where row-level security backs it up
One webhook endpoint finds the tenant from the invoice index
A frequent cron claims each tenant's morning run
Model calls count per tenant under one shared ceiling
